Download **A-Tale-of-Todos-macOS.zip** below. It runs on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs with **macOS 14 or later**. No Xcode or Swift installation is needed.

1. Unzip the download and drag **A Tale of Todos.app** into Applications.
2. Open the app. This build is ad-hoc signed and is not notarized, so macOS may block the first launch.
3. If blocked, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**, then confirm opening the app. See [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/102445).

This is an early version for trying the app. Your data stays on your Mac.
